blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court (SC) has ruled that employees cannot be forced to retire before the compulsory retirement age of 65 without them giving clear and voluntary consent to their respective companies. In a decision promulgated on June 29, the SC’s First Division partly granted the petition of Rodolfo Ondevilla against Colegio de San Juan de Letran in Laguna (CSJL), which had considered his appointment as school comptroller expired after he turned 60 in 2019. Ondevilla filed an illegal dismissal complaint against the CSJL before the Labor Arbiter and the National Labor Relations Commission, where he won the case. READ: SC […]...
